verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged by changing only host and credentials. It also explicitly states that BI and dashboard tools that connect to ClickHouse (Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau, DBeaver) connect without glue. Missing for 10: explicit naming of JDBC/ODBC drivers, per-tool BI setup guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these connections.
